title: The History of the Internet: From Four Computers to Five Billion People
description:
In 1969, four university computers were quietly connected in a lab. Fifty years later, five billion people are online. This is the story of how the internet was built — and how it changed everything.

#Internet #TechHistory #Documentary #WorldWideWeb #ARPANET #TimBernersLee #VintCerf
